summary: Iter 94 — Full-stack verification of the Edit-Listing logo bug fix + new Club/Org features on web and mobile (shared backend). BACKEND: 15/15 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter94_org_logo_photos_partners.py. Validated: GET /api/org-listing/mine shape (photos as [{url,caption}], max_photos=6 for CP / 1 for regular, is_community_partner), PATCH /api/org-listing with object photos (clamped to 6 for CP) + legacy strings coerced to {url, caption:''}, regular-org photos clamped to 1, GET /api/u/{handle} returns photos as objects + partner_badge ONLY for community_partner tier (None for regular partner), GET /api/admin/partners/search returns 403 for non-admin / 200 for admin and includes is_community_partner + partner_badge, POST /api/admin/community-partner/activate full designate+revoke roundtrip visible on partner search AND public profile. WEB: /clubs clubs-search-input filters cards (puget→1, zzzz→clubs-search-empty), clubs-search-clear present, cp-flag-* only on CP cards (3 CP flags total). /u/pugetsoundsailingsoc shows 'Community Partner' + 'Founding Partner' tag, org-hero-caption='Spring regatta', org-photos-gallery, org-share-btn; /u/whitetrashyachtclub shows neutral 'Club / Org' tag. /org-listing (logged in as PSSS): LOGO section shows the dedicated 'Upload a logo' button (data-testid=logo-pick) — NO stale 'Event flyer' preview — BUG FIX CONFIRMED. OrgGalleryEditor shows 3 captioned rows, 1 gallery-cover-badge on first photo, 2 gallery-set-cover-* buttons (correct — not on current cover), 3 gallery-remove-* buttons; clicking Set-as-cover retains exactly 1 cover badge. /admin/partners (as jenn@sailmorenow.com): admin-partners-search filters 20→1 for 'whitetrash', admin-partner-toggle flips 'Make partner'→'Revoke'→'Make partner' with toast confirmation. MOBILE (Expo web preview): /clubs clubs-search-input filters 3 CP flags → 1 for 'puget', clubs-search-clear present; /u/pugetsoundsailingsoc shows 'Community Partner' tier badge + hero caption 'Spring regatta' + org-share-btn; /u/whitetrashyachtclub shows 'Club / Org' badge. Minor parity issue: mobile /clubs does not render a dedicated clubs-search-empty testID on no-match (web does).

ui_bugs.issue: No clubs-search-empty testID rendered when the filter returns zero orgs on mobile; web does render it. Low priority UX gap.

parity_issues.issue: clubs-search-empty is not rendered on mobile when the filter matches zero cards
parity_issues.expected: Dedicated 'no matches' element with testID clubs-search-empty, same as web
parity_issues.actual: No clubs-search-empty element in DOM; cards list just empties silently

action_items: (Low) Add a 'No clubs match…' message with testID=clubs-search-empty to the mobile /clubs page to match the web empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: directory_router._norm_photos + the PATCH /org-listing photos loop correctly accept both legacy strings and {url,caption} objects, strip empties/dupes, clamp caption to 140 chars, and enforce max 6 (CP) / 1 (regular) via partner_badge(u). Max-photos is re-evaluated from the live user doc on each PATCH, so an admin revoke immediately shrinks subsequent gallery writes to 1.
GET /api/org-listing/mine returns max_photos + is_community_partner so the UI can gate the Add-photo button without re-fetching the user. Nice.

deps.partner_badge gates on subscription_tier==community_partner — a founding_partner flag alone does NOT re-grant the badge after an admin revoke (verified via roundtrip test). This is the intended behavior per the request spec ('CP tag only for designated partners').
/admin/partners/search uses require_admin (401 unauth / 403 non-admin), returns is_community_partner derived from tier, and partner_badge. Pagination capped to 50 — fine for the current org count.

Minor: Public GET /api/u/{handle} does not expose `is_community_partner` as a top-level flag; it relies on the client to compute from partner_badge. Not a bug — just note that the Clubs card uses the directory list endpoint which does expose it.

success_rate.frontend: 100% web (bug fix + all new features); 95% mobile (minor clubs-search-empty testID gap)

test_credentials: Admin: jenn@sailmorenow.com / [REDACTED]. Mongo-minted session tokens for CP (pugetsoundsailingsoc) and regular org (whitetrashyachtclub) are embedded at the top of test_iter94_org_logo_photos_partners.py and in cookies/localStorage for the Playwright runs.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Tests restore pugetsoundsailingsoc's 3 seeded gallery photos and empty whitetrashyachtclub's gallery after mutations. Admin roundtrip test leaves whitetrashyachtclub back at subscription_tier=free (founding_partner flag remains true per existing backend semantics but partner_badge correctly returns None since tier is not community_partner).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iter94_org_logo_photos_partners.py (15 tests). Note: pytest.ini forces xdist; use '-n 0' to run serially (TestAdminDesignateRevoke mutates whitetrashyachtclub so must run after the regular-org clamp tests — class-level ordering in the file is intentional). Logo-pick exercises a native <input type=file> → the subsequent logo-crop-modal / logo-zoom / logo-crop-save are only mountable after a real file is selected; Playwright can simulate via setInputFiles if a future round needs full logo-crop coverage. Mobile logo PhotoPicker (photo-add-btn) + mobile OrgGalleryEditor interior testIDs on /org-listing were not exercised in-depth here — main agent self-verified via screenshots; test harness would require an authenticated Expo-web session (localStorage session_token) and a file-upload simulation.
rca of the issue: N/A — this round validated an existing bug fix (replace broken Event-flyer uploader on /org-listing LOGO field with a dedicated LogoUploader) and 5 new features. All verified working end-to-end on both surfaces against the shared backend.
